sloka: राक्षसस्त्वं मया जातः पुत्ररूपो दुरासदः ।प्रतिहंसि ममाज्ञां यत् प्रजार्थे विफलो भव ।। ७.५९.१४ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasastvaṁ mayā jātaḥ putrarūpo durāsadaḥ ।pratihaṁsi mamājñāṁ yat prajārthe viphalo bhava ।। 7.59.14 ॥

translations.english: You are a wicked demon born by me in the form of a son, because you reject my command, you shall become fruitless in terms of progeny.
